# StakeStone Staking

> StakeStone Staking is a non-custodial interface for depositing ETH into StakeStone from your own wallet and receiving STONE, a yield-bearing ETH token. STONE does not rebase; its value per token is designed to grow. It is not an official StakeStone site and is not financial advice.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- StakeStone is an omnichain liquid staking and yield protocol; depositing ETH gives STONE.
- STONE is yield-bearing: value per token is designed to grow, and the balance does not rebase.
- STONE can be bridged to supported networks and used in DeFi; a BTC version of the product also exists.
- Withdrawals are processed in rounds or batches, not instantly; STONE can also be sold on a DEX at market price.
- Fees come out of yield; risks include strategy, smart-contract, depeg and bridge risk; gas is paid in ETH.
